description: Marker fixture: three tanks at 30, 65 and 100 percent health, so the health bars show three different fills, and a Commander at 80 to build from. All four belong to the local player. Pause it, then select all (ctrl+a) for the selection rects, ctrl+1 for the group digit, a patrol for the order line and its dots (hold SHIFT to see them; hover a tank for the route dots), a held drag for the band box, and the Commander's build menu for the placement ghost and queued sites. The health bars also need the `damagebars` option.
